title: US top court nixes Trump admin's bid to restrict medical care for transgender inmates
content: a divided appeals court panel declined to lift the block, prompting the administration to approach the Supreme Court . the court refused to let president Donald Trump’s administration immediately enforce restrictions on medical care for transgender inmates . conservative justices Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas dissented, saying they would have allowed the policy to take effect as the case moved through the lower courts .
